bleavit_runtime::RuntimeEvent.covered_by: kind:event (02 §6's ingest set only — NOT the whole enum)
bleavit_runtime::RuntimeEvent.reason: `System.Events` has value `Vec<EventRecord<RuntimeEvent>>`, and expanding `RuntimeEvent` renders every event of every pallet: 2.2 MB, and a drift signal that fires whenever any unrelated pallet gains an event. WHAT IS COVERED, stated exactly because the easy version is too strong: this manifest's 02 §6 event entries freeze the canonical-frontend ingest set, and §6 explicitly does not exhaust pallet-local events -- the runtime enum carries substantially more variants than §6 lists. So the elided subtree is NOT fully covered. The claim is only that everything in it which this contract freezes is frozen by those entries, and the remainder is not contract surface. Consequences, not inferred: an off-contract diagnostic event may appear with no signal here (the latitude §6 already grants), and a new event that SHOULD be in §6 is not caught here either -- no gate derives §6 obligations from runtime source (SQ-586). What remains under check is the `EventRecord{phase,event,topics}` container, which no event entry covers. `Referenda.ReferendumInfoFor` and `Scheduler.Agenda` embed `OriginCaller` and are deliberately NOT elided: nothing else freezes that type, so eliding it would drop coverage rather than duplicate it.
